reuse.why: All providers share the new link preparation helper, Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank, and both unlink paths share clearBankAccountLink.

duplication.why: Fintegra adds copies of the existing account linking workflow and Akahu transaction downloader instead of sharing their common logic.

placement.why: Link policies and local unlink operations belong in accounts/link.ts, while handlers, downloads, configuration, and provider types follow existing module boundaries.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested linking rules, replacement option, Fintegra integration, and supporting tests and registration.

maintainability.why: Centralized link policies simplify future rule changes, but another duplicated linking workflow and downloader increase the number of implementations maintainers must keep aligned.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every link handler calls prepareBankAccountLink and findOrCreateBank, and replacement and explicit unlinking both call clearBankAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: app.ts linkFintegraAccount reproduces the existing provider linking workflow with renamed provider references, and sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions reproduces downloadAkahuTransactions with a different endpoint and log label.

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountLink gains the requested replaceExistingLink option while retaining provider-independent policies; all six provider handlers use it without provider-specific exceptions.
